text:
Hi AWS team — I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning specialist with 6 years of experience building production-focused AI solutions in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and general machine learning.

I want to be upfront: my background is strongest in applied ML and NLP rather than Midjourney-specific visual design. That said, I’m comfortable working with AI systems, iterating on prompts, and collaborating closely with design-minded teams to help shape high-quality outputs. If you’re looking for someone who can contribute technically and communicate clearly in English, I’d be glad to support your growing team.

A couple of relevant projects from my work:
- Telecom churn prediction (p02): I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read. Result: AUC 0.84 on a held-out quarter, with 3.1x top-decile lift.
- Clinical note summarisation (p08): I built a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 model that drafts visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs are masked. Result: ROUGE-L 0.41, and clinician editing time down 38% in a 6-week trial.

What I’d bring to your team is a structured, reliable approach to AI work: careful prompt iteration, fast experimentation, and attention to output quality. In a Midjourney-focused role, I would be most useful in the workflow around prompt testing, versioning, and making the process repeatable and easy to refine alongside your graphic design direction.

AWS2022

If you’d like, I’d be happy to discuss how I can contribute within your current workflow and where I can add the most value as you scale.
